# NHTech — NightHack Technology Private Limited

> Complex business problems. Production systems. Forward-deployed engineers building AI and product systems alongside your team.

NHTech (NightHack Technology Private Limited) is an applied AI systems and product engineering firm based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. NHTech takes complex, mission-critical business problems and converts them into production technology. We combine deep product engineering with state-of-the-art applied AI, embedding senior forward-deployed engineering (FDE) pods directly alongside customer teams from problem definition to deployment and continuous operation.

## Key Facts & Entity Information
- Legal Entity Name: NightHack Technology Private Limited
- Operating Brand Name: NHTech
- Former Brand Name: NightHack Labs
- Corporate Email: info@nighthack.in / aditi.jha@nighthack.in
- Headquarters: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Website: https://nighthack.in/
- Partnerships: OpenAI Select Partner (Specialization in Agent Building and AI Operations)
- Research Roots: AI journey began through foundational research projects with Microsoft R&D India.
- Model Ecosystem: Model-agnostic engineering spanning Small Language Models (SLMs) on edge silicon to frontier reasoning models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, and open-weight architectures).

---

## Primary Capabilities & Core Engineering Tracks

### 1. Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
Senior product and AI engineers embedded directly within client engineering organizations, repositories, and workflows.
- Operating model: Problem Framing → Systems Architecture → Sandboxed Prototype → Legacy Integration → Production Hardening
- Deterministic state machines & human approval gates
- AI implementation & intelligent model routing
- SLMs through frontier models tailored to cost, latency, and security
- Direct integration into legacy enterprise ERP, CRM, and transactional backends
- URL: https://nighthack.in/fde

### 2. Vision & Edge AI
High-frequency computer vision, kinematic tracking, and on-device machine learning with zero cloud dependency and sub-15ms inference.
- Real-time computer vision and automated defect classification
- Sub-15ms edge inference on TensorRT, ONNX, and specialized edge NPUs
- Vision-Language-Action (OpenVLA) models for physical perception and robotics
- Industrial safety monitoring and shop-floor kinematic analysis
- URL: https://nighthack.in/computer-vision

### 3. On-Prem AI & Sovereign Models
Turn enterprise data into a model you control. Domain model engineering for client-controlled infrastructure.
- Objective benchmarking: RAG vs. fine-tuning vs. distillation based on actual constraints
- LoRA, QLoRA, distillation, and quantization for domain specialization
- Deployment to private-cloud VPCs, on-premise GPU clusters, or air-gapped environments
- 100% client data retention and full model artifact/IP ownership
- URL: https://nighthack.in/on-prem-ai

### 4. Custom Product Engineering with AI & Complex Business Solutions
Translating intricate domain rules, compliance mandates, and legacy systems into resilient, high-throughput software architectures.
- High-volume transactional ledgers and fraud detection streaming pipelines
- Enterprise customer loyalty, incentive, and dynamic reward engines
- Core ERP orchestration (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) without disrupting live operations
- Agentic workflows with deterministic state bounds and immutable audit logs
- URL: https://nighthack.in/what-we-build
- Agentic AI Systems: https://nighthack.in/agentic-ai
- Document Intelligence: https://nighthack.in/document-intelligence

---

## Internal Software Products

In addition to client-deployed engineering pods, NHTech builds and operates specialized software platforms:

### 1. Talkument
- Category: Document & Knowledge Intelligence Platform
- Live URL: https://talkument.co/
- Purpose: Turns complex, unstructured enterprise documents (PDFs, scans, contracts, engineering manuals) into searchable, conversational knowledge with spatial layout awareness, hybrid dense-sparse vector indexing, deterministic citations, and private VPC/air-gapped deployment options.

### 2. Hoot
- Category: Context-Aware Enterprise Communication & Workflow Platform
- Live URL: https://hoot.nighthack.in/
- Purpose: Secure workplace collaboration and real-time multi-channel communication runtime equipped with background agentic triage, decision summaries, contextual knowledge retrieval, and cryptographic audit logging.

### 3. Ottom8
- Category: Deterministic Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestration Engine
- Live URL: https://ottom8.nhtech.link/
- Purpose: Builds, runs, and governs multi-agent AI automations bounded by deterministic state machine graphs, mandatory human-in-the-loop checkpoint gates, temporal event sourcing, and native connectors to SQL, REST, Kafka, and ERPs.

---

## Deployment & Security Archetypes

- Private Cloud VPC: Fully isolated infrastructure inside client AWS, Azure, or GCP accounts.
- On-Premises & Air-Gapped: Zero internet access deployments utilizing self-hosted open-weight LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek).
- Edge Silicon: Low-power on-device perception running directly on factory floor industrial PCs, tablets, and NVIDIA Jetson hardware.
- Intellectual Property: 100% of custom engineered code, weights, schemas, and configurations belong exclusively to the client.
